applicabilityBasis.summary: The tracked BSC USDA token is catalogued as a one-dollar issuer-controlled token, but current Alpha Partners public material describes USDT deposits converted to UCard USD balances and reward points. It does not identify USDA-specific legal issuance, a fixed-dollar token redemption obligation, or a named legal issuer. The available evidence is insufficient to affirm payment-stablecoin applicability or a non-payment exclusion.

genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. Current official site and GitBook corpus describe AP UCard, USDT top-ups, USD card balances, KYC and internal reward points; no current USDA token-specific issuance or fixed-dollar redemption terms were located. The historical catalog contract is 0x17eafd08994305d8ace37efb82f1523177ec70ee on BSC. Worldwide card-use statements and a claimed payment license do not establish USDA token offering, token deposit status, reserve insurance or authorization. The existing descriptive issuerEntity is preserved and does not purport to identify a legal company. Legal identity and domicile remain unresolved; enforcementStatus is omitted because unknown identity prevents a meaningful comprehensive issuer enforcement search. No current public reserve composition, token-holder redemption policy or independent monthly token reserve examination was found in the reviewed public material. Applicability is corrected to unclear rather than retained as apparent-payment-stablecoin solely on historical catalog metadata. A September 11, 2025 AlphaPartners promotional announcement mentions USDA payment aspirations and regulatory progress but supplies no legal issuer, binding dollar redemption terms or actual regulatory authorization. The opened body does not substantiate the search-index claim of completed French/German regulatory evaluations.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, issuer qualification-intent statement or registered foreign exception was located in the checked sources. Current material does not identify the USDA legal issuer, limiting negative-evidence completeness and preventing an issuer pathway assignment. This is a bounded public-source result, not proof that no private filing or authorization exists.
